name: North Sea
description: Your home beach with the aquarium. Cool water full of herring and cod.

name: Coral Reef
description: Warm clear water over colourful corals of the Indo-pacific. Start a second beach business from scratch; building here costs more.

name: Australia
description: The Great Southern Reef: cool kelp forests full of seadragons, rays and great white sharks.

name: Japan
description: Rocky shores, the warm Kuroshio current and some of the deepest trenches on Earth.

name: South Africa
description: Where two oceans meet: kelp forests, the sardine run, sharks and southern right whales.
